integrity: Analytical proof in RESULT.md; standalone deterministic numerical checks in checks.py. Numerics are not substituted for the proof; no independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem for independent two-state Markov chirality, fixed speed, positive harmonic stiffness and independent Gaussian rotational/translational noise. Slow-flip endpoint is a stationary positive-rate limit; no claim for nonlinear traps, non-Markovian flips, entropy production, or complete stationary distribution.
title: Faster biased chirality reversals strictly amplify trapped orbital circulation
